message.subject: Collaboration with EDXSO
message.email_body: Your audience gains practical technical depth from exploring how AI changes software engineering. Uma Abu, your video on AI Took The Joy Out Of Coding caught our attention for its reflective approach. EDXSO works with schools on academic outcomes, leadership and sustainable institutional growth, and we would like to propose an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video for teachers and school leaders, with format and terms to be discussed. This helps your viewers navigate modern tech changes in education. Please reply if a short call this month would suit you.
message.dm: Uma Abu, your video on AI Took The Joy Out Of Coding stood out. Would you be open to discussing an exploratory co-created educational resource about practical technology in schools?
